en.headline: Prince of Wales Hospital doctor arrested over alleged unauthorised examinations
en.dek: A 31-year-old doctor employed by CUHK has been suspended from clinical duties after police arrested him on suspicion of indecent assault involving two patients last month.
body: Police arrested a 31-year-old doctor on suspicion of indecent assault after he allegedly conducted physical examinations on two male patients in a paediatric surgical ward at Prince of Wales Hospital without authorisation from the attending team.

The hospital said the incident occurred in the early hours of 30 October. Ward staff stopped the examinations when they noticed the irregularity and reported it to management. The hospital then notified police. It has suspended the doctor from clinical duties, barred him from all clinical areas, and revoked his access to medical systems.

Assessments of the two patients found their clinical condition and treatments were unaffected. The hospital apologised to their families and said it would continue to provide necessary support. It reported the matter through the Hospital Authority's early incident reporting system.

The doctor, who performed teaching and clinical work at the hospital, was employed by the Chinese University of Hong Kong Faculty of Medicine. The university said it was highly concerned, has suspended all his duties, and would investigate according to procedures while cooperating with police. Police said the man was released on bail and the case is being handled by the Sha Tin district crime squad.

zh.headline: 威爾斯親王醫院醫生涉非禮被捕 院方禁止進入臨床範圍
zh.dek: 一名31歲中大醫學院醫生上月疑在兒童外科病房為兩名男病人進行未經授權檢查，警方拘捕後獲准保釋，院方已暫停其臨床工作。
body: 警方拘捕一名31歲醫生，涉嫌非禮。據威爾斯親王醫院表示，該名醫生上月30日凌晨疑在兒童外科病房先後為兩名男病人進行身體檢查，但有關程序未獲主治團隊授權。
病房職員發現後即時阻止並向管理層報告，院方其後報警。醫院已禁止該醫生進入所有臨床範圍，終止其臨床工作及登入醫療系統權限。院方強調高度重視病人安全，並已透過醫管局早期事故通報系統呈報。
院方指已為兩名病人進行評估，臨床情況及治療未受影響，並已向家屬詳細交代及致歉，會繼續提供所需支援。該醫生受僱於香港中文大學醫學院，在威院負責教學及臨床工作。
中大表示高度關注事件，形容性質嚴重，已暫停該名教員所有職務，並按程序調查，同時配合警方。警方指被捕人獲准保釋候查，案件由沙田警區重案組跟進。
